disease_label_per_paper: Eosinophilic myocarditis in eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis
presentation_summary: One-year history of asthma and recent sinus surgery, followed by recurrent cough and dyspnea initially treated as pneumonia
Presented with fatigue, dyspnea, right foot numbness, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, tachypalpitations, atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response, and elevated troponin
Initial CBC: WBC 28,800/uL with eosinophil count 12,960/uL (45%) despite low-dose oral corticosteroids
ESR 35 and CRP 4.14; admission troponin 16.28; renal function and lactate were unremarkable
CTA chest showed bilateral peribronchial thickening and patchy ground-glass/nodular opacities; cardiac MRI showed myocardial edema and delayed enhancement consistent with myocarditis
Rheumatologic workup including p-ANCA, c-ANCA, MPO, and PR3 was inconclusive; IgE and IgG were markedly elevated
